question: The Garba dance is performed in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __Gujarat__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__****Garba:**

 
• It is a popular folk dance of Gujarat.
 
• It is performed throughout nine nights of Navaratri.
 
• It is performed by the womenfolk of Gujarat. 
 
• Garba danced around the symbol to honour the fact that all humans have the Divine energy of Devi within them.
